m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You need some golem parts?  Well, you know all those golems in the Golem Tower?
If you battle them I'm sure you'll get a bunch of spare parts. As many as you need!
Hello there, what can I do for you?
Moolinda Wu is working on a clockwork?  And she's having a few problems?  Ah, let me see those parts.  I can fix anything.
There you go.  She should be all set with these.  Tell Moolinda hello and good luck for me.
How wonderful!  These should be excellent!
Oh my.  These don't seem to fit.  Let me think...
I've got it!  Take these to Kirby Longspear.  He should be on Colossus Boulevard.  He can modify these parts to make them fit.
How wonderful of Kirby to modify these parts for me.  I guess we should give them a try!
Oh this is so wonderful!  He's animating!  I can't thank you enough.  Here's your reward for all your hard work.
I need to get some parts to fix this clockwork.
Look!  I found a broken clockwork.  I think I can fix him, but I'm going to need some parts.
Can you find some parts for me?  I'm not sure where to get them.  Perhaps Professor Balestrom knows where to find some.
